items.text: Could you fly four astronauts around the Moon... and bring them home?
AstroByte is a co-op game: four roles design a space mission from real NASA data.
Mass, power, budget and data compete. When the team agrees: liftoff!
The figure-eight free return is real physics, validated with NASA GMAT.
Real lunar data. Three parachutes. Splashdown.
AstroByte. Team ASTROBYTE, for NASA Space Apps 2026.
